subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Teams inbound attachment fix land as the broader no-new-config channel repair, the narrower default-off group-chat fallback, or a combined approach?
rationale: Current main is still broken, but the two open closing PRs make different product/config tradeoffs around Graph lookup frequency, channel support claims, and operator-facing configuration.

options.title: Land the broader channel repair
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent patch that fixes team GUID resolution, fallback triggering, and thread-reply URL construction for the original channel report.

options.title: Narrow to group-chat fallback
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 only for the proven group-chat path and keep this issue open for the remaining channel URL/root-message bugs.

options.title: Combine the approaches
options.body: Keep the default-off fallback if desired, but also include the channel team GUID and reply URL repair before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land the broader channel repair
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 or an equivalent patch that fixes team GUID resolution, fallback triggering, and thread-reply URL construction for the original channel report.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to Peter Steinberger as the broadest current msteams plugin-boundary contributor, and the unresolved choice is primarily product/config direction rather than a simple code edit.
